hook.en: The organisation chart on the office wall shows who reports to whom. But the news of a bonus often reaches everyone first through the canteen. Both are organisations.
hook.kn: ಕಚೇರಿ ಗೋಡೆಯ ಚಾರ್ಟ್ ಯಾರು ಯಾರಿಗೆ ವರದಿ ಮಾಡಬೇಕೆಂದು ತೋರಿಸುತ್ತದೆ. ಆದರೆ ಬೋನಸ್ ಸುದ್ದಿ ಮೊದಲು ಕ್ಯಾಂಟೀನ್ ಮೂಲಕವೇ ಹರಡುತ್ತದೆ. ಎರಡೂ ಸಂಘಟನೆಗಳೇ.

narration.en: The organisation chart on the office wall shows who reports to whom. But the news of a bonus often reaches everyone first through the canteen. Both are organisations.
narration.kn: ಕಚೇರಿ ಗೋಡೆಯ ಚಾರ್ಟ್ ಯಾರು ಯಾರಿಗೆ ವರದಿ ಮಾಡಬೇಕೆಂದು ತೋರಿಸುತ್ತದೆ. ಆದರೆ ಬೋನಸ್ ಸುದ್ದಿ ಮೊದಲು ಕ್ಯಾಂಟೀನ್ ಮೂಲಕವೇ ಹರಡುತ್ತದೆ. ಎರಡೂ ಸಂಘಟನೆಗಳೇ.

body.en: Formal organisation is the structure of authority and responsibility deliberately designed by management. It specifies relationships, follows the scalar chain and rules, and makes it easy to fix responsibility. But it can delay action and ignores social needs.

points.en: Official, written rules and scalar chain
Easy to fix responsibility; may be slow

narration.en: Formal organisation is the structure of authority and responsibility deliberately designed by management. It specifies relationships, follows the scalar chain and rules, and makes it easy to fix responsibility. But it can delay action and ignores social needs.
narration.kn: ಔಪಚಾರಿಕ ಸಂಘಟನೆಯನ್ನು ಆಡಳಿತ ಉದ್ದೇಶಪೂರ್ವಕವಾಗಿ ರೂಪಿಸುತ್ತದೆ; ಅದು ಶ್ರೇಣಿ ಸರಪಳಿ ಮತ್ತು ನಿಯಮಗಳನ್ನು ಪಾಲಿಸುತ್ತದೆ.

title.en: On the board: formal and informal

narration.en: Watch the board as we build this up step by step.

say.en: On the left, the formal chart: a neat pyramid of boxes.
On the right, the informal network: friendships cutting across departments.
Compare them: who creates them, how communication flows, and how fast.

narration.en: Sort each statement: formal organisation or informal organisation.
narration.kn: ಪ್ರತಿ ಹೇಳಿಕೆಯನ್ನು ಔಪಚಾರಿಕ ಅಥವಾ ಅನೌಪಚಾರಿಕ ಸಂಘಟನೆ ಎಂದು ವಿಂಗಡಿಸಿ.

prompt.en: Sort each statement: formal organisation or informal organisation.
prompt.kn: ಪ್ರತಿ ಹೇಳಿಕೆಯನ್ನು ಔಪಚಾರಿಕ ಅಥವಾ ಅನೌಪಚಾರಿಕ ಸಂಘಟನೆ ಎಂದು ವಿಂಗಡಿಸಿ.

explanation.en: Formal organisation is the planned structure of authority; informal organisation grows from social interaction inside it.

text.en: Makes it easy to fix responsibility
Can delay action because of procedures
Spreads news fast through the grapevine
May spread rumours and resist change

body.en: Informal organisation arises from the social interaction of people at work. It has no written rules, spreads information quickly through the grapevine, satisfies social needs and helps fulfil goals. But it may spread rumours, resist change and push members to follow group norms.

points.en: Merits: fast communication, social needs met
Limits: rumours, resistance to change, group pressure

narration.en: Informal organisation arises from the social interaction of people at work. It has no written rules, spreads information quickly through the grapevine, satisfies social needs and helps fulfil goals. But it may spread rumours, resist change and push members to follow group norms.
narration.kn: ಅನೌಪಚಾರಿಕ ಸಂಘಟನೆ ಕೆಲಸದ ಸ್ಥಳದ ಸಾಮಾಜಿಕ ಸಂಪರ್ಕದಿಂದ ಹುಟ್ಟುತ್ತದೆ; ಸುದ್ದಿ ಬೇಗ ಹರಡುತ್ತದೆ, ಆದರೆ ವದಂತಿಗಳೂ ಹರಡಬಹುದು.

problem.en: In a Mysuru bank branch, clerks who travel together by the same bus learn about a new scheme before the official circular and help each other learn the new software. Name the type of organisation and two of its benefits.

steps.en: The group arose from travelling together, not from management: informal organisation.
News reached them before the circular: faster spread of communication.
Helping each other with software: helps fulfil organisational goals and social needs.

answer.en: Informal organisation: fast communication and support to organisational goals.

narration.kn: ತರಗತಿ ರಸಪ್ರಶ್ನೆ. ಬೆಂಚಿನಲ್ಲಿ ಚರ್ಚಿಸಿ, ಕೈ ಎತ್ತಿ, ಮಾನಿಟರ್ ತರಗತಿಯ ಉತ್ತರವನ್ನು ಒತ್ತಲಿ.

points.en: Formal organisation is designed by management and follows the scalar chain.
points.kn: ಔಪಚಾರಿಕ ಸಂಘಟನೆ ಆಡಳಿತ ರೂಪಿಸಿದ್ದು, ಶ್ರೇಣಿ ಸರಪಳಿ ಪಾಲಿಸುತ್ತದೆ.

points.en: Informal organisation grows from social interaction.
Grapevine is fast but may spread rumours.

homework.en: Distinguish between formal and informal organisation.

narration.en: Recap. Formal organisation is designed by management and follows the scalar chain. Informal organisation grows from social interaction. Grapevine is fast but may spread rumours.
narration.kn: ಪುನರಾವರ್ತನೆ. ಔಪಚಾರಿಕ ಸಂಘಟನೆ ಆಡಳಿತ ರೂಪಿಸಿದ್ದು, ಶ್ರೇಣಿ ಸರಪಳಿ ಪಾಲಿಸುತ್ತದೆ. ಅನೌಪಚಾರಿಕ ಸಂಘಟನೆ ಸಾಮಾಜಿಕ ಸಂಪರ್ಕದಿಂದ ಬೆಳೆಯುತ್ತದೆ. ಗ್ರೇಪ್‌ವೈನ್ ವೇಗ, ಆದರೆ ವದಂತಿಯೂ ಹರಡಬಹುದು.
